findings.body: This PR removes `package-lock.json` entirely (the prior pin of `semver-utility@6.3.0` and its integrity entry go with it). The description frames the change as a routine lockfile bump / dependency refresh, but a bump updates pins in place — deletion leaves installs unpinned and drops the only recorded integrity hash. Restore the lockfile (or regenerate it from a `package.json` in the same PR) unless the intentional goal is to stop locking dependencies.

summary:
## Verdict

Small, intentional logging tweak in `src/index.ts`; the accompanying lockfile change is a full **deletion**, not a dependency refresh.

## What changed

- `src/index.ts`: `main()` now logs `cfg.env` alongside `cfg.appName` after `get("config")`. That matches the PR title. `./fetcher` is not in this tree, so the shape of `cfg.env` could not be verified — if it is only a stage name (`production` / `staging`), this is fine; if it ever carries full environment maps or secrets, stdout logging would be the wrong sink.
- `package-lock.json`: removed entirely (was a lockfileVersion 3 pin of `semver-utility@6.3.0`). The description calls this a "lockfile bump," but the diff deletes the file. There is also no `package.json` on either side of the PR, so the lockfile was already orphaned — still, dropping the only pin removes the last recorded integrity/version anchor for that package.

## Notes

- No repository instruction files (`AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / review extensions) were present to check convention rules against.
- Omitted lockfile contents were inspected via `git diff` only enough to confirm status = deleted (not to review package graphs).

**Recommendation:** request-changes
